title: Forms of business in which banking companies may engage
verbatim_text: (1) In addition to the business of banking, a banking company may engage in any one or more of the following forms of business, namely: (a) borrowing, raising or taking up of money; lending or advancing of money; (b) acting as agents for any Government or local authority or any other person; (c) contracting for public and private loans and negotiating and issuing the same.
source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962

title: Penalties for contravention of Banking Companies Ordinance
verbatim_text: (1) Whoever in any return, balance-sheet or other document or in any information required or furnished by or under or for the purposes of any provision of this Ordinance, wilfully makes a statement which is false in any material particular, knowing it to be false, or wilfully omits to make a material statement, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.
source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962
